basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: 21 to 65 years (as on date of publication of the advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate degree with minimum 60% marks in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Child Development, Psychiatry, Counselling, Human Rights, Criminology or Law; good knowledge of Punjabi
qualification.details: Other conditions: | Applicant should be residing in Pathankot or working in Pathankot Applicant should have good knowledge of Punjabi language Female applicants will be given preference | Desirable: | Experience in Child Protection, Counselling, Psychology, Social Work or Legal Aid will be given preference

how_to_apply: Fill the Application Proforma attached to the notice.
Send the application only by registered post to Office District Child Protection Unit, Pathankot, Room No. 219, Second Floor, District Administrative Complex, Pathankot 145001.
Applications can be sent from the date of publication of the advertisement up to the last date, 30.11.2026 (5.00 PM).
important_instructions: If the last date falls on a government holiday, the next working day will be the date for receipt of applications Honorarium paid subject to availability of budget from Government of India and State Government Any amendment to the recruitment notice will be published on https://pathankot.nic.in Selection Committee has full rights to fill the posts; final authority rests with Deputy Commissioner, Pathankot Legal jurisdiction lies with the Hon'ble Court, Pathankot Organisations working in child rights or child protection and officials of a children's home or shelter home may also be eligible

content_sections.text: Advt No. 1452/12/2026-27/17105 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DCPU Pathankot notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Applicant should be residing in Pathankot or working in Pathankot Applicant should have good knowledge of Punjabi language Female applicants will be given preference Desirable: Experience in Child Protection, Counselling, Psychology, Social Work or Legal Aid will be given preference

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DCPU Pathankot Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons involved in any criminal case, social or moral turpitude, or crime against women and children

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement for three years, reviewed yearly by the DCPO May be extended beyond 3 years on DCPO recommendation approved by the District Magistrate Posts are purely temporary and honorarium-based; no possibility of regularisation No fixed duty hours; services taken whenever a POCSO case is received

content_sections.heading: How Will DCPU Pathankot Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of eligible candidates Personal interview by the Selection Committee Selection Committee evaluates qualification, experience of working with children and personal interaction Selection Committee recommends a panel of names for Support Persons

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates Experience certificates Proof of residence

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: If the last date falls on a government holiday, the next working day will be the date for receipt of applications Honorarium paid subject to availability of budget from Government of India and State Government Any amendment to the recruitment notice will be published on https://pathankot.nic.in Selection Committee has full rights to fill the posts; final authority rests with Deputy Commissioner, Pathankot Legal jurisdiction lies with the Hon'ble Court, Pathankot Organisations working in child rights or child protection and officials of a children's home or shelter home may also be eligible

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Pathankot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DCPU Pathankot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for Support Person.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DCPU Pathankot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Proforma on pages 4-5 of this notice) and send it to Office District Child Protection Unit, Pathankot, Room No. 219, Second Floor, District Administrative Complex, Pathankot 145001, by registered post only, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 65 years (as on date of publication of the advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 600 per case per visit (honorarium).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate degree with minimum 60% marks in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Child Development, Psychiatry, Counselling, Human Rights, Criminology or Law; good knowledge of Punjabi.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant should be residing in Pathankot or working in Pathankot. Applicant should have good knowledge of Punjabi language. Female applicants will be given preference.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons involved in any criminal case, social or moral turpitude, or crime against women and children.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of eligible candidates. Personal interview by the Selection Committee. Selection Committee evaluates qualification, experience of working with children and personal interaction. Selection Committee recommends a panel of names for Support Persons.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement for three years, reviewed yearly by the DCPO. May be extended beyond 3 years on DCPO recommendation approved by the District Magistrate. Posts are purely temporary and honorarium-based; no possibility of regularisation.
